# 2026-04-14 OpenClaw Ultimate Wiki Bootstrap Session

## What happened
This session pivoted away from EMA-as-app ideation and toward recovering the old Discord/OpenClaw/QMD/vault system into one new Ultimate Wiki / knowledge backbone.

## Key outcomes
- treated the old vault as first-class prior art
- defined the Ultimate Wiki direction
- wrote architecture, source-map, migration, ingest, query, writeback, and source-of-truth docs
- reframed the goal as bootstrapable through current OpenClaw + Discord + vault/QMD + durable writeback

## Important current truth learned
- OpenClaw is running and actively in use
- the current system already has real runtime, channels, agents, and memory
- the next step is no longer just planning; it is active ingest and writeback

## Next steps
- ingest current OpenClaw truth into durable pages
- begin old-vault mapping into new hub structure
- create stronger hub/index pages
- use this session as the first true chronicle entry in the new system
